## opencode 1.0.53

Stable release from `main` branch. Accepted reasoning replacements now refresh the visible TUI, and pull requests are gated directly against main.

---

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- **Live reasoning replacement**: A same-ID replacement redraws the accepted text instead of retaining the old highlighted code frame. Short thoughts use Markdown rendering; thoughts over 4 KiB use complete plain text so a full rewrite remains responsive. Markdown markers are visible in the plain-text mode. In-progress reasoning still renders appended text.
- **Reading position**: A replacement after the current viewport keeps the numeric scroll position; bottom-following continues to show the latest content when the block height changes. A semantic anchor inside a rewritten reasoning body is not retained.

---

### ⚙️ CI / Engineering

- **Direct main delivery**: Pull requests to `main` are gated by Typecheck, Linux unit tests, generated-code and HttpAPI checks, and Linux and Windows E2E. The retired `dev` integration path no longer controls CI or releases.
- **Stable-only publishing**: Manual release builds reject non-main refs and select the next version from stable `graphagent-v*` tags. Historical dev tags remain records but do not advance the version.

---

### 🧪 Test Summary

```
TUI package: 280 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed
Reasoning replacement: same-ID event to visible frame, append, full rewrite, and scroll cases passed
Release version and workflow routing: targeted tests passed
Main pull request: Typecheck, Linux unit, Linux E2E, and Windows E2E are checked before publication
```

---

### 🔍 Verification

A fixed OpenTUI 100x30 benchmark measured 40 full-body replacements of a 56.6 KB reasoning part, changing every section from the first one. All 40 updates became visible. The old code path took 182.92 ms at p95; the plain-text path took 7.98 ms at p95. A three-part transcript with one long part updated per event took 7.63 ms at p95. A 3.8 KB Markdown replacement took 11.06 ms at p95; crossing the 4 KiB threshold between 56.6 KB plain text and 3.8 KB Markdown took 11.04 ms at p95, with one of 40 updates exceeding a 16.7 ms frame interval. Initial long-body expansion took 4.02 ms. These are local test-renderer measurements, not a terminal-wide latency guarantee. Current-head CI, release assets and an installed binary are checked independently as part of release acceptance.
